open_questions.q: Does the vortex<->meron correspondence survive in the full four-band SU(4) moire model, where sigma(r) also acquires contributions from the non-Abelian (interband) Berry connection and the QGT, not just the in-plane d-offset?
open_questions.basis: Paper Fig.2 shows sigma from both the QGT and diagonal non-Abelian A_nn(k); our reduced 2-band model collapses these into a single in-plane offset, which is why our cos-angle is an idealized 1.0.
open_questions.next_steps: Implement the 4-band TB model (paper Methods) with genuine non-Abelian connections; recompute sigma(r) and measure the realistic |cos(sigma,P)| < 1.

open_questions.q: What sets the quantitative resonance omega_M ~ 6 eV (and omega_K ~ 5 eV) at which the antiparallel locking is sharpest, and how wide is the frequency window?
open_questions.basis: Paper attributes omega_M to M-point BZ-edge transitions between trivial bands; our reduced model only shows the SIGN is a lower/upper-branch (frequency-window) property, not the absolute energies.
open_questions.next_steps: Add realistic hBN hopping parameters and band energies; compute the frequency-resolved sigma^{a,bc}(omega) and locate the antiparallel window quantitatively.

open_questions.q: How do the individual shift-conductivity tensor components (sigma_{y,yy}, sigma_{y,xx}, sigma_{y,xy}, sigma_{x,xy}) and their stacking-dependence (AA/AB/DW) reproduce paper Fig.3?
open_questions.basis: We compute only the net vector direction of sigma(r); the paper resolves the full third-rank tensor per stacking with symmetry relations (sigma_{y,xx} = sigma_{x,xy} for AA/AB).
open_questions.next_steps: Compute the full sigma^{a,bc} tensor from the two-band model first (analytic), then the four-band, and check the symmetry-enforced component equalities.

open_questions.q: Is the topological meron charge robust to a realistic (non-idealized) polarization profile f(rho), and to a full moire NETWORK of merons+antimerons rather than a single core?
open_questions.basis: We verified quantization for an isolated meron and an isolated antimeron; the paper's MPD network tiles many of each with domain-wall solitons between AB/BA domains.
open_questions.next_steps: Build a periodic multi-meron tiling on the moire lattice; verify total charge and per-core windings, and that sigma vortices appear at every core.

open_questions.q: Can the predicted antiparallel sigma-P optical fingerprint be connected to an experimentally measurable observable (photocurrent map vs. polarization map), including realistic dephasing/lifetime broadening eta?
open_questions.basis: The paper proposes this as a 'sought-after strategy' for experimental detection; our Lorentzian eta is a placeholder, and we do not model measurement resolution.
open_questions.next_steps: Parametrize eta from measured linewidths, convolve sigma(r) with a realistic optical spot, and estimate the current magnitude/SNR needed to resolve a single vortex.
